candidate_rule: Only papers with independently verified formal acceptance may enter new baseline list. Prioritize direct STVG E3M, runnable episodic localization T3AL, then URPA if its distinct model/source-training/target-adaptation budget is actually available and suitable. Do not promise three runnable canonical STVG baselines when assets/code/interfaces differ. Domain-specific methods are primary; MEMO/EATA supplemental, CoTTA reserve with separate stream controls.

observed_HC.explanation: Parameter/logit changes do not imply a discrete interval or metric gain. Native and jointMAP readouts are different. The jointMAP change from nativeSource cannot be attributed to optimizer updates.

hypotheses: Updates change logits but are too small or direction-preserving relative to legal interval score margins.

Only temporal-decoder norm affine is adapted; detached upstream context, frozen endpoint head and fixed spatial boxes limit expressivity. This is a scope limit, not evidence the original methods universally fail.
SAR reliability thresholds reject all eligible rows for some steps; inspect per-row valid support length, normalized entropy, first-mask intersection and second-threshold filtering.

Missing original-paper optimization conditions: normalization exclusions, SGD momentum/SAM, gradient scale, clipping, per-step detach/autocast/train-eval/reset, update-before-inference and no stale-cache readout.
Native per-offset hull vs jointMAP and whole-metric aggregation can hide or introduce changes; keep readout-only controls identical.
